verdict.rationale: Checkout payment-method acceptance is a fair question for a creator commerce platform like Gumroad, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, or BNPL at checkout. The only related items are local-currency pricing and a community grep finding PayPal and Stripe as backend vendors. Both are adjacent and do not show buyer-facing wallets or local payment methods.

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer digital wallets and local payment methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) from the same integration
